# Settings rows in the smallest window (1280x720 at GUI scale 4 = 320x180): a choice too wide for its row shows the
# picked name between arrows (Look tab: Colour, Font; Display tab: the Record card's Corner) instead of running off
# the row's left edge; sliders under their names. Then German, and the Music tab's Status in Spanish at GUI scale 2
# ("Reproduciendo la canción de prueba" in full).
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f script=.github/checks/controls-small.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6
set recordCard true
guiscale 4
gui 1
sleep 3
shot look-en
scroll -2
sleep 1
shot look-en-2
scroll -2
sleep 1
shot look-en-3
gui 3
sleep 3
shot display-en
scroll -2
sleep 1
shot display-en-2
scroll -2
sleep 1
shot display-en-3
close
lang de_de
sleep 15
gui 1
sleep 3
shot look-de
gui 0
sleep 3
scroll -3
sleep 1
shot lyrics-de-2
close
lang es_es
sleep 15
guiscale 2
gui 2
sleep 3
shot music-es-g2
close
